criteria.label: Annual energy service / useful output
criteria.boundary: The unit and service boundary must be explicit. More output is not automatically preferable if demand, quality, cost, or impacts differ.

criteria.label: System efficiency
criteria.boundary: Efficiency must preserve the conversion/system boundary. It is not interchangeable with capacity factor, reliability, or total energy use.

criteria.label: Capital cost
criteria.boundary: Currency, price year, included cost categories, financing treatment, and system scope must be declared before comparison.

criteria.label: Net present value
criteria.boundary: NPV is only comparable when discount rate, lifetime, cash-flow boundary, currency, price basis, and residual-value treatment are compatible.

criteria.label: Cost efficiency
criteria.boundary: The outcome denominator must be identical or reconciled across alternatives; cost per kWh saved and cost per tonne CO2e avoided are different criteria.

criteria.label: Energy access / affordability context
criteria.boundary: Country access indicators and project/user affordability evidence are context inputs, not interchangeable measures or automatic equity conclusions.

criteria.label: Energy security / import dependency context
criteria.boundary: Import dependency is one security dimension. Negative values, stock coverage, supplier concentration, infrastructure, and resilience must retain source semantics.

criteria.label: Renewable-energy share context
criteria.boundary: Renewable electricity share and renewable final-energy share have different denominators and must not be silently substituted.

criteria.label: Greenhouse-gas emissions / removals
criteria.boundary: Direct, lifecycle, avoided, biogenic, land-carbon, and removal accounting boundaries must be explicit. Biomass carbon neutrality is never assumed.

criteria.label: Land, water, biodiversity and ecosystem context
criteria.boundary: Environmental dimensions are not collapsed into a single impact score. Geography, baseline, threshold, attribution, and ecosystem context must be preserved.

criteria.label: Reliability, adequacy and flexibility context
criteria.boundary: v0.9.0 can carry supplied reliability/flexibility evidence but does not run dispatch, adequacy, grid-stability, or storage-physics models.

criteria.label: Implementation, governance and delivery context
criteria.boundary: Permitting, institutions, supply chains, workforce, acceptance, policy, and delivery risk require explicit evidence and are not inferred from technology labels.
